def choose_move(observation):
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    sx, sy = observation.get("self_position", (0, 0))
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", (0, 0))

    # Defensive helpers
    def sign(a):
        return 0 if a == 0 else (1 if a > 0 else -1)

    # Pursuit-Evasion
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = observation.get("self_role", "pursuer")
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx = sign(ox - sx)
            dy = sign(oy - sy)
            return [dx, dy]

        # If evader, head toward farthest corner to maximize escape distance
        width = observation.get("grid_width", 1)
        height = observation.get("grid_height", 1)
        corners = [
            [0, 0],
            [0, height - 1],
            [width - 1, 0],
            [width - 1, height - 1],
        ]
        # choose corner with maximum Manhattan distance from opponent
        target = max(corners, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - ox) + abs(c[1] - oy))
        dx = sign(target[0] - sx)
        dy = sign(target[1] - sy)
        return [dx, dy]

        targets = observation.get("unclaimed_cells") or observation.get("territory_targets") or []
        if not targets:

            if center:
                dx = sign(center[0] - sx)

                return [dx, dy]
            return [0, 0]

        dx = sign(best[0] - sx)
        dy = sign(best[1] - sy)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Resource collection

    if not resources:
        # fallback: move toward opponent to disrupt
        dx = sign(ox - sx)
        dy = sign(oy - sy)
        return [dx, dy]

    best = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0] - sx) + abs(r[1] - sy))
    dx = sign(best[0] - sx)
    dy = sign(best[1] - sy)
    return [dx, dy]
